Use case: targeted UI correction. Refine LH07-0110. The Japanese mock is authoritative for the 366x588 sheet geometry and text scale. Image 2 is the current edit target. Image 3 controls icon/control anatomy.
Match these preview coordinates: first group card x16,y106,w334,h240; nested fields x28,w322 with y178,h40 and y294,h40; second group card x16,y390,w334,h129; theme selector x270,y410,w80,h38; bottom action x16,y532,w334,h40, bottom y572 with 16px margin. Compared with v001: shrink and inset both white group cards by 8px horizontally; move the first inner label start from x72 to x58; move the fields right 4px while widening them 4px; reduce the first group by 8px in height; move the second group up 6px and reduce its height by 7px; move the theme selector right to x270 and reduce width from about120 to80; move the action up10px, inset it 4px on both sides and increase height to40px. Keep the second row and all labels at compact preview scale. Recolor purple/blue icons to Lighthouse forest green for the category glyphs, and use slate for unselected details. Exact text: クイック設定; 言語と地域; 表示言語; ボタンや案内の表示に使用します。; 英語（英国）; 地域; 検索結果に使用する地域です。; 米国; 検索の設定; テーマ; 表示方法を選びます。; 安全な検索; 露骨な内容を除外します。; すべての設定. Preserve the Aa, globe, brush, shield, three theme modes and current third-mode selection. No added content, whitespace, purple accent, oversized text, or phone/browser chrome.
